parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The edge instance ID. In the IoT Platform console, go to **Edge Computing** > **Edge Instances**, and hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The interaction rule ID for scene orchestration. Invoke the [QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~) operation to obtain the scene orchestration rule ID.
